digest.component_or_area: autodeploy edge detection / nginx config re-render
propositions: infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template source template is absent from every component path manifest in autodeploy.sh, so merged edge changes are never detected
edge-only deltas are never signaled to the operator and fail silently with no AUTODEPLOY_ERROR, unlike CONFIG_PATHS which emits a signal
Option A fix adds EDGE_PATHS detect-only manifest and mirrors CONFIG_PATHS detect+signal block without implementing unattended render/nginx-reload (deferred to v2 epic 6d60)
merged change a61d (25fd2cf6dd75) to rebar.conf.template is undeployed and invisible, confirmed by mtime predating deploy and proxy_redirect count mismatch
new test verifies AUTODEPLOY_ERROR signal is emitted when only rebar.conf.template changes, covering the regression
